title: Phase 3 execution, Layer 2: round 3 — verify the round-2 fixes, re-decide the stop

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH MANIFEST (declared before the spend). invoked_by: the standing continuation conduct. vehicle: the Workflow orchestration surface, attended side. round shape: VERIFY — each lens adversarially verifies the round-2 fixes (#756-#763, commit a49206fe) AND the core-removal migration (#764, commit 74b01866) in its scope, tries to refute each fix claim, sweeps the changed surfaces for regressions and new defects; the round's output re-decides the stop. domains, the same four (the change set lands on the same surfaces, plus the new schema shim): software-engineer (the channel-based subprocess collection, the full-refname listing, the schema shim's engine fidelity), security (the whole-run deadline's completeness, sanitize ordering and coverage, the shim's value-free message discipline), quality-engineer (the equality pin's two-directional strength, the stale-gate falsifiers and clean negatives actually falsifying, the unit pins), data-engineer (the five new fixtures as data, the amended gloss against the code, the binary-driven conformance tests' fidelity to what the lib pipeline proved). MODEL, CHOSEN: claude-fable-5 all four. EFFORT, CHOSEN: software-engineer and security HIGH, quality-engineer and data-engineer MEDIUM (unchanged posture). expected_cost_band: 0-10 findings pre-dedup, 150k-350k downstream tokens — recalibrated from round 2's observed 314,456 (the round-2 declaration under-called verify-posture depth by 26%; this band prices reproduction-chasing in). inputs: the tree at the round-2 fix-pass boundary (74b01866 + a49206fe + the changelog mirror), the nine closed children with result records, the #755 trail. returned + telemetry recorded here after.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 3 RETURNED (the stop-deciding verify over a49206fe + 74b01866). Verdict grid: 36 verdicts across four lenses — 33 held, 3 incomplete (all three the #763 gauge half, by software-engineer, security, and quality-engineer; data-engineer checked the manifest half and read held); no fix regressed. The migration (#764) held on all four lenses — engine, version, and draft fidelity confirmed against the sibling repo, the binary-driven tests verified on both exit paths. Quality-engineer re-ran executed scratch-copy mutants: the equality pin fails both directions, each stale-gate fixture catches exactly its dropped conjunct, each clean negative catches its over-firing mutant by name. Stop: NOT reached — 3 of 4 lenses continue (data-engineer alone stops). Four findings consolidated to children: #766 (major: the #763 gauge-conflation declaration never landed in acquire.rs while the close record asserts it did — the defect's second half stands and the record overstates; process cause identified: an unasserted text replacement collided with the same-turn vocabulary sweep and silently no-opped), #767 (minor, ALL FOUR lenses convergent: sanitize folds degenerate HOME spellings — a single space turns every space in git stderr into tildes, a bare slash every separator — diverging from the same commit's own trimmed-non-empty rule), #768 (minor QE: a descendant holding only the stderr write-end past a clean exit converts a fully-acquired run into TimedOut, contradicting the declared best-effort stderr posture), #769 (minor security: the migrated cross_references tests kept a hand-rolled predictable temp path with a delete-then-create race — the sibling suite already rides tempfile). TELEMETRY, chosen versus observed: model chosen=observed claude-fable-5 on all four; effort chosen=observed (SE and security high, QE and DE medium); cost band DECLARED 150k-350k, OBSERVED 368,192 with 168 tool invocations — over the ceiling by 5% even after the round-2 recalibration; two rounds of under-calling verify depth say the next verify declaration prices at 200k-400k. Fix pass follows; round 4 re-decides the stop on a narrowed scope.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Round 3 fix pass COMPLETE (870836ce; changelog mirror follows). All four children closed with results, each verified in the tree before its close — the #766 lesson applied in the same pass that closed it. Gates: 97 tests pass / 0 fail, clippy zero, fmt clean, mdatron verify clean. Round 4 dispatches next: the stop-deciding verify, scope narrowed to the four fixes and a regression sweep of their two files' surfaces.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Round 3 complete: caught the misreported #763 half (record corrected before code), four children #766-#769 fixed in 870836ce and verified by round 4. Closed at the Layer 2 sign-off (decision on #770).
